log_dir.description: Directory where chat log files are stored. Must be writable by the ejabberd process.

format.description: Format of log files. Choose 'text' for plain text or 'html' for styled web-readable logs.

max_days.description: Maximum age (in days) for log files. Older logs are automatically deleted. Set to 0 to keep logs indefinitely.

muc_log.description: If true, log group chat (MUC) messages in conference rooms.

private_log.description: If true, log private one-on-one chat messages.

compress.description: If true, compress rotated log files with gzip to save disk space.

file_mode.description: File permissions for log files, in octal notation (e.g., '0640' = owner read/write, group read, others none).

file_prefix.description: Prefix for log filenames (e.g., 'chat' → chat-2024-06.log). Use empty string for no prefix.

vhosts.description: List of XMPP virtual hosts (domains) to log chat for. Leave empty to log all vhosts.

items.description: An XMPP domain (e.g., 'example.com') to enable logging for.

module_path.description: Fully-qualified Erlang module name for the chat logging module (rarely changed).
